brief.meaningEn: Circulate widely among people, often through repeated sharing.
brief.meaningZh: 在人群之間經多次轉傳而廣泛流傳。
brief.grammar: Usually a story, rumour, joke or image does/has done the rounds; the phrase describes circulation, not verification.
brief.register: Informal newsroom update: an editor tells reporters a rumour has reached several community groups while its truth remains unconfirmed.
brief.boundaryZh: 流傳範圍廣並不代表消息已證實，也不一定代表正式發布。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是人真的走完巡邏路線，也不能因多人轉傳便當作事實。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出訊息如何傳播，並把傳播程度與真偽分開。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 62, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The false story had already done the rounds.

listening.en: The same unverified rumour appeared in five neighbourhood chats by noon. It had done the rounds before the council made any announcement.
listening.zh: 同一則未核實傳聞到中午已出現在五個街坊群組。市議會尚未公布消息，它已廣泛流傳。
listening.promptZh: had done the rounds 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The rumour had been shared widely.
options.zh: 傳聞已廣泛轉傳。

options.en: The council had officially confirmed the rumour.
options.zh: 市議會已正式證實傳聞。

options.en: The rumour was corrected before anyone shared it.
options.zh: 傳聞在有人轉發前已被更正。

options.en: Only one person had seen the message.
options.zh: 只有一個人看過訊息。

listening.explanationZh: 五個群組都有同一傳聞，顯示它已流傳；真偽仍未證實。

reply.promptEn: Why did the teacher address the exam-date rumour in class? It had been repeated in several student chats, although the school had not confirmed any change.
reply.promptZh: （老師為何在課堂澄清考試日期的傳聞？它已在多個學生群組重複出現，但學校未確認任何改動。）

options.en: Several student groups had already shared the rumour.
options.zh: 多個學生群組已轉傳傳聞。

options.en: The teacher needed to address its spread, not treat it as confirmed.
options.zh: 老師須回應它的傳播，並非把它當作已證實。

options.en: The rumour had done the rounds before any official confirmation.
options.zh: 傳聞在獲官方確認前已廣泛流傳。

options.en: The rumour reached enough students to merit clarification.
options.zh: 傳聞已傳到足夠多學生耳中，值得澄清。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均承認傳聞廣傳但未獲證實；金句用 done the rounds。

scene.promptZh: 一張活動海報在多個部門的聊天群組反覆轉發，但主辦單位仍在修改時間。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The draft poster has done the rounds, though its time may still change.
options.zh: 海報草稿已廣泛流傳，但活動時間仍可能改動。

options.en: The final event time is certain because many people shared the poster.
options.zh: 很多人轉發海報，所以活動時間一定已定。

options.en: No one beyond the designer has seen the poster.
options.zh: 除設計師外，沒有人看過海報。

scene.explanationZh: 多個群組轉發支持廣泛流傳；草稿上的時間仍未確定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說 the story has done the rounds？

options.en: The story reaches dozens of parent groups through forwarding.
options.zh: 故事經轉發傳到數十個家長群組。

options.en: An unsent draft remains on one writer’s private laptop.
options.zh: 未發出的草稿只留在一位作者的私人電腦。

options.en: Several local newsletters repeat the same story.
options.zh: 多份地方通訊重複報道同一故事。

contrast.explanationZh: 未發出的私人草稿沒有流傳。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「傳聞已做了很多轉發，所以肯定是真的。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: It may have done the rounds, but sharing is not verification.
options.zh: 它或許已廣泛流傳，但轉發不等於核實。

options.en: Wide circulation proves that the date has changed.
options.zh: 廣泛流傳證明日期已改。

options.en: A rumour cannot spread until an official notice appears.
options.zh: 未有正式通知前，傳聞不可能傳開。

dialogue.explanationZh: 廣傳與真偽是兩個不同判斷。

speaking.en: The outdated route map had done the rounds in local chats, so the organiser sent everyone the revised version.
speaking.zh: 舊路線圖已在本地群組廣泛流傳，因此籌辦人向各人發出修訂版。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明為何需要發出修訂版。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：遺失寵物的尋找告示先在十個社區群組廣泛轉發，翌日主人找到寵物，但舊告示仍在流傳。用一至兩句英文交代傳播情況和更新，不要把舊告示說成最新消息。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出舊告示已廣泛流傳、寵物已找回、須更新訊息。

examples.en: The lost-pet notice had done the rounds in ten community groups; after finding the pet, the owner sent an update because the old notice was still circulating.
examples.zh: 尋找寵物的告示已在十個社區群組廣泛流傳；找回寵物後，主人發出更新，因舊告示仍在轉傳。

examples.en: Because the original notice had done the rounds in ten community groups, the owner posted a correction when the pet was found the next day.
examples.zh: 原告示已在十個社區群組廣泛流傳，因此主人翌日找回寵物時，發帖更正消息。

takeaways.en: When news has done the rounds, it has circulated widely, whether or not it is accurate.
takeaways.zh: 消息廣泛流傳時，不論真偽，均可說它已廣傳。

takeaways.en: A story doing the rounds may need an update when the facts change.
takeaways.zh: 消息廣泛流傳後若事實改變，可能需要更新。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Source is guide-written provenance; practice scenes are newly written. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Trust given without examining evidence or possible weaknesses.
brief.meaningZh: 未審視證據或可能問題便給予的信任。
brief.grammar: Noun phrase blind trust, often contrasted with informed trust; blind describes the absence of scrutiny, not eyesight.
brief.register: Measured editorial judgement: an editor asks junior reporters to verify a claim before publishing without assuming every source is dishonest.
brief.boundaryZh: 審慎查證不等於完全不信任；片語批評的是缺乏查證。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是視力問題，也不是要求對所有人一概懷疑。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清有根據的信任、盲目信任和一概不信任。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 63, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The editor wants informed trust, not blind trust.

listening.en: The report cites one anonymous post but no documents. The editor asks for records before publication: informed trust, not blind trust.
listening.zh: 報告只引用一篇匿名貼文，沒有文件。編輯要求刊出前查看紀錄：要有根據的信任，不要盲目信任。
listening.promptZh: blind trust 在這裏指甚麼？

options.en: Accepting the post without checking its claim.
options.zh: 未查證便接受貼文的說法。

options.en: Checking records before deciding whether to rely on the post.
options.zh: 先核對紀錄，再決定是否依據貼文。

options.en: Rejecting every source regardless of its evidence.
options.zh: 不論證據如何，一概否定所有消息來源。

options.en: Rejecting the post as false without checking it.
options.zh: 未經查證便斷定貼文虛假。

listening.explanationZh: 盲目信任是未經查證便接受說法；編輯要求相反做法。

reply.promptEn: Why does the charity treasurer ask to see receipts before approving a reimbursement? The volunteer may be honest, but the team has not yet checked the amount.
reply.promptZh: （慈善機構司庫為何在批准報銷前要求看收據？義工可能是誠實的，但團隊尚未核對金額。）

options.en: Receipts let the team verify the amount before paying.
options.zh: 收據讓團隊付款前核對金額。

options.en: Checking evidence does not mean accusing the volunteer of lying.
options.zh: 核對證據不代表指控義工說謊。

options.en: The treasurer wants evidence rather than blind trust.
options.zh: 司庫要有證據，不願盲目信任。

options.en: The team can trust the volunteer responsibly after checking.
options.zh: 核對後，團隊可以有根據地信任義工。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都支持核對資料而不武斷指控；金句用 blind trust。

scene.promptZh: 一間商店聲稱產品可節電一半，卻尚未提交測試數據；採購員要求看報告才下單。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The buyer avoids blind trust by asking for test results.
options.zh: 採購員要求測試結果，以免盲目信任。

options.en: The buyer knows the product is fraudulent without any evidence.
options.zh: 採購員未有證據，卻已知道產品是騙局。

options.en: The claim is proved true because the shop repeated it.
options.zh: 商店多說幾次，就證明聲稱屬實。

scene.explanationZh: 索取數據是先查證再信任，既不盲信也不先定罪。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個例子最不屬於 blind trust？

options.en: A manager signs off a figure without opening the attached report.
options.zh: 經理不看附件報告便批准數字。

options.en: A buyer compares the claim with independent test results before ordering.
options.zh: 採購員下單前把聲稱與獨立測試結果比較。

options.en: A reader accepts an anonymous post solely because it has many likes.
options.zh: 讀者只因匿名貼文獲很多讚好就相信它。

contrast.explanationZh: 先比較獨立測試結果是有根據的判斷。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「要求對方給證據就是不信任對方。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: Checking a claim can replace blind trust with informed trust without calling anyone dishonest.
options.zh: 核對聲稱可把盲目信任轉為有根據的信任，毋須指責任何人不誠實。

options.en: If we trust someone at all, we must skip every check.
options.zh: 只要信任對方，就必須省略所有核對。

options.en: Asking for evidence proves the person lied.
options.zh: 要求證據就證明對方說謊。

speaking.en: The coach read the injury report before approving the player’s return; she wanted informed judgement rather than blind trust.
speaking.zh: 教練批准球員復出前閱讀傷患報告；她希望作有根據的判斷，而非盲目信任。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出教練根據甚麼作判斷。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區委員會考慮推薦一項募款計劃；宣傳材料聲稱款項全用於服務，但尚未提供財務報告。委員會要求先看紀錄，不打算在證據不足時指控籌辦人。用一至兩句英文交代態度。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出尚未提供報告、委員會要求查看紀錄，並避免把審慎查證說成已證實欺詐。

examples.en: The committee wants the financial records before recommending the fundraiser; without a report, blind trust in the spending claim would be premature.
examples.zh: 委員會推薦募款計劃前要查看財務紀錄；未有報告時盲信款項用途的聲稱，為時過早。

examples.en: Rather than offer blind trust or accuse the organisers, the committee asks for a financial report to check the spending claim.
examples.zh: 委員會既不盲目信任，也不指控籌辦人，而是索取財務報告核對款項用途的聲稱。

takeaways.en: Blind trust accepts a claim without enough checking.
takeaways.zh: 盲目信任指未充分查證便接受聲稱。

takeaways.en: Avoiding blind trust means using evidence, not accusing someone without proof.
takeaways.zh: 避免盲目信任是參考證據，並非無憑無據地指責別人。

brief.meaningEn: Keep known news or information to oneself instead of telling others; in silence intensifies the withholding.
brief.meaningZh: 知道消息卻暫不告訴別人；in silence 強調默不作聲。
brief.grammar: Pattern sit/sat/sitting on it or on the news/information; in silence is an optional intensifier, and it refers to withholding information rather than sitting physically.
brief.register: Conversational personal update: a student tells a friend that she kept a scholarship result confidential until the named announcement time.
brief.boundaryZh: 壓着不說不一定不當；守約或尊重保密安排時也可能合理。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是坐在物品上；也不能從保持沉默推斷消息一定負面。
brief.outcomeZh: 能交代誰知道消息、為何暫不說，以及何時可以分享，而不武斷評價保密行為。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 64, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She could not sit on it in silence after the result arrived.

listening.en: Mira knew the scholarship result on Monday but had promised to wait until Friday’s school notice. She sat on it in silence for four days.
listening.zh: 米拉星期一已知道獎學金結果，但答應等到星期五學校公布。她默默把消息壓了四天沒有說。
listening.promptZh: sat on it in silence 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: She kept the result to herself until the agreed announcement.
options.zh: 她把結果暫時藏在心裏，等約定時間公布。

options.en: She had not received the result until Friday.
options.zh: 她直到星期五才收到結果。

options.en: She told everyone the result on Monday.
options.zh: 她星期一便把結果告訴所有人。

options.en: The result was necessarily bad news.
options.zh: 結果一定是壞消息。

listening.explanationZh: 米拉已知道結果但按約定暫不分享；片語並不判斷消息好壞。

reply.promptEn: Why did Arun wait to tell his sister about the surprise reunion? He knew the date, but the family agreed to reveal it together on Sunday.
reply.promptZh: （阿倫為何等到星期日才告訴妹妹驚喜聚會的日期？他早知道日期，但家人約定星期日一起公布。）

options.en: He kept the date private until the shared reveal.
options.zh: 他在共同公布前把日期保密。

options.en: He honoured the family’s agreed announcement time.
options.zh: 他遵守家人約定的公布時間。

options.en: He sat on the news in silence until Sunday.
options.zh: 他默默把消息壓着不說，直至星期日。

options.en: He knew the date but chose not to tell his sister earlier.
options.zh: 他知道日期，但選擇不提早告訴妹妹。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述按約定暫不分享；金句用 sit on the news。

scene.promptZh: 義工提前知道抽獎得主，但活動主持安排在台上宣布，她便一直未透露。哪句最貼切？

options.en: She sat on the information until the host announced it.
options.zh: 她把消息壓着不說，直至主持宣布。

options.en: She told every attendee before the announcement.
options.zh: 她在宣布前告訴每位參加者。

options.en: She had forgotten the winner’s name.
options.zh: 她忘了得主姓名。

scene.explanationZh: 她知道結果而暫時保密；沒有證據說她忘記了。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說 someone sat on the news？

options.en: A club secretary knows the award result but waits for the agreed ceremony.
options.zh: 學會秘書知道得獎結果，但等到約定典禮才說。

options.en: A reporter announces a confirmed result as soon as she receives permission.
options.zh: 記者一獲批准便公布已證實結果。

options.en: A friend learns about a surprise party and keeps it private until the guest arrives.
options.zh: 朋友知道驚喜派對後，一直保密至嘉賓到場。

contrast.explanationZh: 獲准後立即公布，不是在已知消息後把它壓着不說。

dialogue.promptZh: 有人說：「她沒有立刻分享結果，所以一定做錯事。」但她承諾先等學校正式通知。你怎樣回應？

options.en: She sat on it in silence to honour the agreed timing; withholding is not automatically wrong.
options.zh: 她默默把消息壓着不說，是為遵守約定時間；暫不分享不一定是錯。

options.en: Keeping a promise proves the result was harmful.
options.zh: 遵守承諾證明結果有害。

options.en: If she knew the result, she must have told everyone already.
options.zh: 她若知道結果，就一定已告訴所有人。

dialogue.explanationZh: 守約可構成合理保密理由，不能憑沉默判斷對錯。

speaking.en: She had good news on Tuesday but sat on it in silence until the team could hear it together on Friday.
speaking.zh: 她星期二已知道好消息，但默默壓着不說，等到星期五讓團隊一起聽到。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出她等待的原因和期限。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友已知道驚喜畢業聚會的日期，但全班約定周五才一起告訴畢業生；朋友一直守口如瓶，並非忘了通知。用一至兩句英文描述她的保密及原因。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出她已知道日期、依約在周五前保密、不是忘記告知。

examples.en: She knew the surprise graduation party date, but sat on it in silence until Friday because the class had agreed to tell the graduate together.
examples.zh: 她已知道驚喜畢業聚會日期，但因全班約好一起告訴畢業生，所以默默把消息壓着不說，直至星期五。

examples.en: The class agreed on a Friday reveal, so she sat on the news in silence despite knowing the party date already.
examples.zh: 全班約好星期五公布，所以她雖已知道聚會日期，仍默默把消息壓着不說。

takeaways.en: To sit on the news means withhold it for a time, not physically sit on an object.
takeaways.zh: 把消息壓着不說是暫不透露，不是實際坐在物件上。

takeaways.en: Someone may sit on it in silence to honour a promise; the phrase alone does not judge the choice.
takeaways.zh: 有人會為了守約而默默把消息壓着不說；片語本身不判斷這個決定的對錯。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Source is guide-written provenance; practice scenes are newly written. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Of an emotion, become visibly expressed or spread into another response or setting.
brief.meaningZh: 指情緒明顯流露，或延伸到另一種反應或情境。
brief.grammar: Emotion such as joy, relief or excitement spills/spilled over into + visible reaction; the same verb can literally describe liquid, but this lesson teaches the emotional use.
brief.register: Warm but accurate celebration account: a student describes how her team’s relief became audible cheers after a science-fair result.
brief.boundaryZh: 情緒流露可以引起笑聲或歡呼，但不必推斷現場每個人都感受相同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是液體溢出，也不是只要有人高興便必然感染所有人。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出甚麼情緒流露、以甚麼可觀察方式表現，並避免誇大其他人的反應。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 64, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: At the reunion, joy tends to spill over into laughter.

listening.en: When the choir heard it had won, the singers smiled and then burst into cheers and applause. Their relief spilled over into applause.
listening.zh: 合唱團得知獲勝後，團員先微笑，隨即歡呼並鼓掌；他們的如釋重負化為掌聲。
listening.promptZh: relief spilled over into applause 表示甚麼？

options.en: Their relief became visible and audible in their reaction.
options.zh: 他們的如釋重負在反應中明顯流露。

options.en: Their relief stayed private and produced no outward reaction.
options.zh: 他們只在心裏鬆一口氣，沒有流露任何反應。

options.en: Every person in the building felt exactly the same emotion.
options.zh: 大樓裏每個人的感受完全相同。

options.en: They had been applauding before hearing the result.
options.zh: 他們在聽到結果前已鼓掌。

listening.explanationZh: 片語說情緒轉為可見可聞的反應，並非液體外溢。

reply.promptEn: What happened when the volunteer team learned the missing dog was safe? They first looked relieved, then began laughing and clapping; the owner thanked them.
reply.promptZh: （義工隊得知走失的狗平安無事後有甚麼反應？他們先鬆一口氣，然後笑着鼓掌；主人向他們道謝。）

options.en: Their relief showed in laughter and clapping.
options.zh: 他們的如釋重負透過笑聲和掌聲流露。

options.en: The volunteers’ quiet relief became an open reaction.
options.zh: 義工原本安靜的放心，變成明顯反應。

options.en: Their relief spilled over into laughter and applause.
options.zh: 他們的如釋重負化為笑聲與掌聲。

options.en: The team reacted openly after hearing the dog was safe.
options.zh: 團隊得知狗平安後，明顯流露情緒。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以可觀察反應描述情緒；金句用 spilled over into。

scene.promptZh: 比賽結果公布時，隊員先鬆一口氣，接着擁抱和歡呼。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Their relief spilled over into hugs and cheers.
options.zh: 他們的如釋重負化為擁抱和歡呼。

options.en: Their relief remained completely hidden.
options.zh: 他們完全沒有流露如釋重負的感覺。

options.en: The judges shared the same relief and hugged one another.
options.zh: 評判同樣鬆一口氣，並互相擁抱。

scene.explanationZh: 擁抱和歡呼是情緒明顯流露的方式。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以說 joy spilled over into laughter？

options.en: A reunion guest smiles, then starts laughing with friends.
options.zh: 重聚的嘉賓先微笑，然後與朋友笑起來。

options.en: A guest feels pleased internally but shows no visible reaction.
options.zh: 嘉賓心裏高興，但沒有任何外顯反應。

options.en: A team’s excitement becomes loud cheers after the result.
options.zh: 團隊得知結果後，興奮化為高聲歡呼。

contrast.explanationZh: 片語要求情緒有可見可聞的外顯或延伸；只有內心感受不足。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「有人高興得笑起來，便代表現場所有人一樣高興。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: Their joy may spill over into laughter, but that does not tell us how everyone else feels.
options.zh: 他們的喜悅可以流露為笑聲，但這不能說明其他每個人的感受。

options.en: One laugh proves that every person shares the same joy.
options.zh: 一個人笑，就證明人人有同樣的喜悅。

options.en: Their laughter proves they had felt no anxiety beforehand.
options.zh: 他們的笑聲證明之前完全沒有焦慮。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可描述特定人的情緒流露，不應憑此推論所有人的心情。

speaking.en: At the reunion, joy spilled over into laughter when the old friends recognised one another.
speaking.zh: 重聚時，老朋友認出彼此，喜悅便流露為笑聲。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出喜悅變成甚麼反應。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：科學展覽的學生團隊得知作品獲獎，原本緊張的成員先鬆一口氣，然後一起歡呼；旁邊一名評判只是點頭，未見她歡呼。用一至兩句英文描述團隊情緒如何流露，不要代評判猜想。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出團隊得獎、由緊張或放心變成歡呼，不要聲稱評判也歡呼或感受相同。

examples.en: When the students won the science fair, their relief spilled over into cheers; the judge beside them merely nodded.
examples.zh: 學生在科學展覽獲獎後，如釋重負化為歡呼；旁邊的評判只點了點頭。

examples.en: The team had been nervous, but after the award was announced, their joy spilled over into loud cheers while the judge simply nodded.
examples.zh: 團隊本來緊張，但獎項公布後，他們的喜悅化為高聲歡呼，而評判只是點頭。

takeaways.en: Joy can spill over into laughter when it becomes openly expressed.
takeaways.zh: 喜悅明顯流露時，可以化為笑聲。

takeaways.en: An emotion spilling over in one group does not prove everyone nearby shares it.
takeaways.zh: 一組人情緒流露，不能證明旁邊人人感受相同。
